{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-ga-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"18241e2a9f4906261934c05062d9193e4d86c1e32469344508f13451b5b517ce","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-ga-class-c:lineage:38","source_registry_sha256":"e082bc406bec2cfadcd011c884a136274a0200b40ae5a1536777a259a1b09eb3","source_liveness_sha256":"899bb7b77ecc9a36dd3203950c0cfa2065e4529a11881605f77eacb7d739a757"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Warning, guide, construction and service signs","heading":"Warning, guide, construction and service signs","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## Warning, guide, construction and service signs

FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A01
Warning signs are generally yellow with black markings, sometimes fluorescent green with black markings. They announce a hazard or traffic change immediately ahead that may require action. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A01
A warning for successive sharp turns to the right and then left announces that sequence of road direction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A01
A sharp-right-turn warning and a right-curve warning describe different changes of alignment ahead. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A01
A winding-road warning announces a series of bends ahead. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A01
A side-road warning can identify a joining road, including one entering at an angle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A01
A crossroad warning means another road intersects the highway ahead. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A01
Where the road ends ahead, slow and be ready to yield or stop before turning left or right. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A01
A narrow-bridge warning calls for caution because the bridge ahead has room for only 2 traffic lanes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A01
A dip warning identifies a depression in the road ahead and calls for slowing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A01
A bump warning identifies a raised irregularity ahead and calls for slowing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A01
A soft-shoulder warning means the road edge cannot be treated like the regular traveled surface; use that shoulder only in an emergency. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F12 | anchor: A01
A divided-highway-begins warning advises preparation for a change of lane position as separated roadways begin. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F13 | anchor: A01
A divided-highway-ends warning advises preparation for a lane-position change as the separation ends. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F14 | anchor: A01
A warning that a separated one-way roadway becomes two-way means opposing traffic will soon share the highway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F15 | anchor: A01
At a low-clearance warning, do not enter the underpass if either the vehicle or its load exceeds the posted maximum height. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F16 | anchor: A01
At a steep-hill warning, slow and prepare to use a lower gear to control speed and protect the brakes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=31]

FACT_ID: sec09-F17 | anchor: A02
A traffic-signal-ahead warning calls for reducing speed before the intersection. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F18 | anchor: A02
A slippery-when-wet warning calls attention to reduced traction; the handbook identifies the first half hour of rain as especially hazardous. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F19 | anchor: A02
A merging-traffic warning from the right advises preparing to let that traffic join safely. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F20 | anchor: A02
Crossing warnings can announce areas where animals, people or other vehicles may enter the road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F21 | anchor: A02
A yield-ahead warning calls for slowing and readiness to stop if necessary; a stop-ahead warning calls for slowing and preparing for the required stop. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F22 | anchor: A02
Drivers must stop and stay stopped while pedestrians occupy the crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F23 | anchor: A02
The warning marking the start of a no-passing zone is placed on the road's left side; any passing maneuver must finish before that point. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

FACT_ID: sec09-F24 | anchor: A02
An advisory-speed plaque accompanying a warning identifies the speed advised for the warned condition. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=32]

Misconceptions: An exit or route number is not a speed limit; a service sign guides toward a facility rather than overriding a traffic restriction.
Mnemonic: Warn of the condition, guide to the destination, obey the closure.
Glossary: A guide supplies route information; a service sign points to a facility; a crossbuck identifies a rail crossing.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Toll eligibility, exemptions, operating hours, network descriptions and sign-asset rights remain verification debt.
